summary: Join our training to explore the critical role of water in climate strategies. Learn effective solutions to enhance sustainability and achieve climate targets.
lede: Water management is central to climate goals because it affects resilience and the success of both mitigation and adaptation. For climate, sustainability, ESG, water and infrastructure professionals, this course addresses the practical task of integrating water risks into plans and investment decisions. You’ll learn to map hotspots, design adaptation and mitigation interventions, prioritize options by cost and resilience value, and select indicators for monitoring and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various sectors who are responsible for integrating water considerations into climate strategies and ensuring sustainable outcomes.
audience: Public sector planners and policy staff
Agriculture, food systems, and natural resources managers
Risk, compliance, and internal audit teams
modules: Water as the Hidden Engine of Climate Action
Understanding Water Risks That Disrupt Climate Targets
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of climate change principles and some experience in project management or environmental planning.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
